scope: fixed public baseline resource adaptation; exploratory comparison on already-accessed tests
test_notice: Previous Test results are already known. No settings, categories, sample selection or PCA dimensions are selected from new Test results.
layer_aggregation: mean of raw intermediate hidden_states, excluding CLS; no L2 normalization
preprocess: HF slow BitImageProcessor, RGB, full-frame bicubic448, ImageNet mean/std, no center crop
training: all 12288 normal train images; no gradients, augmentations, Test PCA, masks or whitening
pca_estimation: float64 centered sufficient mean and M2 via exact batch-merge; unbiased Npatch-1 covariance; full symmetric eigen decomposition; no per-batch rank truncation
score: sum squared float32 reconstruction residual; PCA parameters cast to float32 to match public implementation
render: OpenCV INTER_LINEAR32->448, GaussianBlur3x3 sigma4 BORDER_DEFAULT reflect101, OpenCV INTER_LINEAR448->256; persist raw float32, no imagewise normalization

score_definitions.max: maximum of saved float32 256x256 raw anomaly map
score_definitions.top1p: float64 mean of largest floor(0.01*65536)=655 saved pixels

metrics: same source-sealed exact common256 evaluator; GT nearest256; all normal background; AUPRO@0.30 equal regions/8-connectivity
selection: original frozen first normal and first anomaly in every category; include all categories and regressions
visualization: same palette and fixed per-panel 1%/99% display percentile rule, with each panel raw range shown; different score units are not calibrated across methods; raw persisted/evaluated maps unchanged
adaptations: combine official small/448 mean-layer ablation backbone with full-normal, no-augmentation training
one-pass centered sufficient statistics replacing repeated feature extraction and eager PIL lists; identical PCA objective up to float64 rounding
no returned attention tensors because optional saliency masks are disabled; keep eager attention
use common256 exact evaluator rather than native448/300-threshold approximate evaluation
claim_boundary: This is a public method baseline reproduction variant; exceeding PaDiM would not by itself establish an original improvement or SCI acceptance.
